Class InventoryItem

java.lang.Object
data.InventoryItem

    • getStockComparison

      public String[] getStockComparison(String restockTo, String restockFrom)
      Used for Restock Reporting, it takes in two locations [RestockTo is the location that needs the stock, and RestockFrom is where the stock will be pulled from] It then asks the restockLocation if has any stock, and if it does it generates the data Array and returns it.
      Parameters:
      restockTo - Location that needs the Stock from the Restock
      restockFrom - Location the Inventory is being pulled from
      Returns:
      Returns Null if the RestockLocation doesn't have stock, else it returns a String array of data

    • getSalesForLocation

      public String[] getSalesForLocation(String location)
      Used to get the sales report for each location, simply returning the count of the item at the location requested.
      Parameters:
      location - Location where the item sold
      Returns:
      Returns a Data Array of the stock at the location.

    • getIncomingStock

      public String[] getIncomingStock(String location)
      Used to Check if there is any incoming stock to a specific location, and if there it is it returns that data.
      Parameters:
      location - Location being checked for Incoming Stock
      Returns:
      Returns null if there is no Incoming Stock, otherwise it will return a data array of the incoming stock.

    • getSpotCheck

      public String[] getSpotCheck(String location)
      Used to Get Spot Checks for a location, Simply checking to see if at a location the stock is negative.
      Parameters:
      location - Location being checked for negatives.
      Returns:
      Returns Null if the location isn't negative, Otherwise it returns an array of data.

    • getZeroes

      public String[] getZeroes(String location, String restockLocation)
      Used to get the Zeroes based off the locations given. If there is no stock (incoming or available) in the location given, and there is stock in the restockLocation then it returns an array of Data with that info.
      Parameters:
      location - Location that is being checked for Zeroes
      restockLocation - Location used to pull the inventory from
      Returns:
      Returns Null if it hits a fail condition, otherwise it returns the String Array of Data
